title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Sunrise Musical Theatre, Sunrise | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Sunrise Musical Theatre in Sunrise, Florida, USA, on 3 June 2000.

It was the 17th show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the Sunrise Musical Theatre on 2 and 3 June 1992, 4 and 5 August 1995, 17 May 1997, and 27 March 1999.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
